# PHASE 0 — Context, Ground Truth, and Whole-Prompt Contradiction Sweep
**SuperGrok2 / SuperGrok1.5 hardening run · 8×H100 (sm_90) · 2026-06-24**
Repo: `github.com/peterc04/SuperGrok1.5` @ `claude/custom-optimizer-analysis-HFYhg` (HEAD `c29ed4e`), cloned to `/workspace/SuperGrok1.5`.

> Method: direct live investigation on the 8×H100 node + an 11-agent parallel exhaustive reread
> (1.4M subagent tokens, 453 tool-uses). Per-subsystem digests are persisted under
> `/workspace/phase0/*.md`. **For existing components the CODEBASE WINS**; every contradiction below
> is *surfaced*, not silently "fixed". Each non-obvious claim carries a `file:line` citation.

---

## 0. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY (what is actually true)

- The repo is a **mature, largely-complete** grokking-optimizer training stack: **44 components → 99 fused
  pipelines** = 11 optimizers × 3 models × 3 archs. The **sm_90 slice = 33 (model,optimizer) cells**.
- The prompt's high-level framing is **right**, but several *specific* assumptions are **stale or wrong**
  against the live tree (see §6). The biggest one: **the "33 megakernels" are NOT 33 distinct compiled
  binaries** — the live reality is **3 real per-model persistent TC megakernels**
  (`fused_{decoder,vit,mamba}_megakernel_tc<Opt>`) parameterized over `OptId`, dispatched by an `opt_id`
  switch. The 33 generated per-cell `mega_<model>_<opt>.cu` files are a **dead/orphaned** representation.
- A **hard environmental blocker** exists: **`ncu` HW performance counters are denied** in this container
  and cannot be enabled (no `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`). This blocks the prompt's counter-based metrics
  (measured occupancy, warp-stall, L2 hit-rate, achieved-FLOP/s via ncu). Counter-free substitutes remain.
- The **genuinely-new work** (prompt's Phase 3 datasets/eval) is **completely unstarted** (grep: zero
  `fineweb`/`imagenet`/`gifteval`). Most of the prompt's Phase-2 "ADD" items are actually **PARTIAL /
  already-present** (codebase-wins → integrate, don't rebuild — see `COMPILE_RECONCILE.md`).

---

## 1. ENVIRONMENT (live-verified 2026-06-24)

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| GPUs | **8 × NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3**, driver 565.57.01, CUDA 12.7 runtime, all idle at start. `detect_arch()`→`90`. |
| Toolchain | CUDA **12.4** `nvcc/ptxas/cuobjdump/nvdisasm`; `ncu` 2024.1.1; `nsys` 2024.1.1 (`/opt/nvidia/nsight-compute/2024.1.1/host/target-linux-x64/nsys`). |
| Python | 3.11.10; `torch 2.4.1+cu124` (sees 8 devices). |
| Disk | `/` overlay 20G (small); **`/workspace` = 311T runpod mfs network volume** (all work here; high small-file write latency). `/dev/shm` 938G. |
| Deps installed this session | `optuna 4.9.0` (compile.py hard-imports it @190), `ruff 0.15.19`, `nvidia-ml-py`/`pynvml`. |
| Absent (expected, sm_90-only) | `jax` (→ tpu_v6e SKIP), `clang`/ROCm/`hipcc` (→ gfx942 SKIP). **Correct per prompt.** |
| CUTLASS submodule | was uninitialized; now checked out (v3.6.0 region `bf9da7b`, `include/cutlass/cutlass.h` present). |

### 1.1 ⛔ BLOCKER — `ncu` hardware counters denied
`ncu` returns `ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM` even as root. Container `CapEff=…a80425fb` lacks `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`; the host
module param `NVreg_RestrictProfilingToAdminUsers` is unreadable/unsettable from inside. **I cannot enable
it from within the container.** This blocks, on this node:
- ncu-measured **achieved occupancy, warp-stall-reason breakdown, L2 hit-rate, issue-slot utilization,
  tensor-pipe (WGMMA) utilization, DRAM throughput counters** — i.e. the prompt's §1.4/§1.5 roofline-via-ncu
  and §1.5 "maximal bottleneck profiling", and Phase-2 **S1.3 measured-occupancy/L2/DRAM cost-model features**.

**Counter-free substitutes that DO work here** (and are how Phase 1/6 will proceed unless counters are enabled):
- **`nsys`** (CUPTI *tracing*, no counter perm): kernel timeline, **one-launch-per-step fusion verification**,
  per-kernel durations, launch counts, memcpy traffic.
- **`cuobjdump -sass` / `nvdisasm`**: instruction presence (HGMMA/WGMMA, TMA/UTMALDG, cp.async), single
  `__global__` entry, register/SMEM, spills — *static, always available*.
- **`ptxas -v`**: registers/SMEM/stack-frame/spill-stores/spill-loads.
- **CUDA events**: wall-clock latency → throughput; **achieved-FLOP/s = analytical_FLOP / measured_seconds**
  and **arithmetic intensity = analytical_FLOP / measured_or_analytical_bytes** → a valid roofline placement
  *without* HW counters (clearly labelled "wall-clock-derived, not counter-measured").
- **`cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor`**: theoretical occupancy from regs/smem.

→ **Decision needed from the user** (raised in the cover note): can the pod be relaunched with profiling
privileges (`--cap-add SYS_ADMIN` or the driver set to `NVreg_RestrictProfilingToAdminUsers=0`)? If yes,
the full ncu suite unlocks. If no, Phases 1/6 deliver the counter-free roofline + bottleneck analysis and
explicitly mark the counter-only metrics BLOCKED.

---

## 2. ARCHITECTURE AS-FOUND (the source of truth)

### 2.1 The 44 → 99 / the "33 cells" — *the most important correction*
- **44 components** = 33 (opt×arch) + 9 (model×arch) + 2 (dispatch+compile) — a README concept
  (`README.md:421-440`), not a literal in code. **99 pipelines** = 3 models × 11 opt × 3 archs
  (`megakernel.py:4`, `MEGAKERNEL_ARCHS=('sm_90','gfx942','tpu_v6e')` `megakernel.py:43`). **`PIPELINES_PER_ARCH==33`** (`compile.py:20443`).
- **11 optimizers** (verified `len==11`): adamw, grokadamw, grokfast, lion, looksam, muon, neuralgrok,
  prodigy, supergrok11, supergrok15, supergrok2 (`dispatch.py:586`). **3 models**: transformer_decoder, vit, mamba3.
- **The 33 sm_90 cells exist as 3 representations**, only the first is live:
  1. **LIVE / compiled / runs:** 3 real per-model TC kernels `fused_{decoder,vit,mamba}_megakernel_tc<Opt>`
     (single `__global__`, plain `<<<>>>`), each parameterized over `OptId` (+3 SG2 launchers). `fused_step`
     dispatches `(model, opt_id)` → the right launcher. This is what `_ops.so` contains.
     `mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc.cu` **compiles OK in 50s** with `-DWITH_CUTLASS -DSG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL=1` (verified).
  2. **Python routing layer:** `_FUSED_L3_REAL` (`dispatch.py:630`) and `_L3_WGMMA_CELLS` (`dispatch.py:1310`)
     each hold **exactly 33** unique `(model,opt)` pairs. This is where "33 cells" is real as a count.
  3. **DEAD generated cells:** `megakernel_codegen.py --write-all` emits 33 `mega_<model>_<opt>.cu` that
     `#include "csrc/fused/sm_90/fused_megakernel.cuh"` + call `launch_fused_megakernel<Model,Opt,Tier>`.
     **Both that header and that launcher were removed in the pure-L3-TC refactor (commit `8b30ea8`)** and
     are absent from HEAD → **these cells DO NOT COMPILE** and are unrouted in `dispatch.cpp`.
  → **Phase-1 implication:** baseline representation **#1** (the 3 `_tc` kernels × 11 opt instantiations),
    NOT the dead generated cells. Record the dead-cell/missing-header as a baseline finding (it is one).

### 2.2 Model sizes (as configured — cite these, do not re-derive)
- **RACE scale** (the grokking matrix): decoder `d_model=128, heads=4, layers=2, vocab=99, seq=4`
  (`grokking_race_v2.py:261,502`); ViT `patch_dim=49, num_patches=16, d=128, heads=4, layers=2,
  num_classes=p=97` (`:417,423`); Mamba-3 `d=128, layers=2, state_dim=128, head_dim=64, expand=2,
  mlp_ratio=2, seq_len=8` (`mamba3_block.py:601-614`).
- **FLAGSHIP scale** (`MODEL_SCALES_BY_MODEL['flagship']`, `grokking_race_v2.py:251-255`): decoder
  `dim=1600, heads=25, layers=48` (~1.5B, GPT-2-XL-ish); ViT `1664/16/48` (~1.8B, ViT-G/14-ish);
  Mamba `2048, heads=32, layers=24, state=128, head_dim=64` (~1.5B).
- Toy scales (MODE E): small `{128,4,2}`~420K, medium `{256,8,4}`~3.5M, large `{512,8,6}`~20M (`:231-235`).

### 2.3 The experiment matrix + budgets (as configured)
- **Default driver `MODE='D'`** = full sweep (`grokking_race_v2.py:2393`, `run_full_sweep :2051`):
  **11 optimizers × 5 seeds `[42,123,456,1337,3407]` × 4 splits `[0.10,0.25,0.50,0.80]` × 3 models = 660 runs**.
- **Splits axis** = `frac_train ∈ [0.10,0.25,0.50,0.80]` (`:2428`); `val_ratio=0.10` (auto 0.05 on 10/90).
  The splits are a deliberate data axis (per the codebase), not replication. ✔
- **Step budget = 20,000** (`early_stop_max_steps` default 20000, `:2314/:2405/:2415`) — **not 15k**.
- Training is **FULL-BATCH** (whole `tx,ty` every step; no DataLoader/minibatching) (`:997,:1072,:1374`).
- **Data = mod-97 only**: decoder `a·b⁻¹ mod 97` = 9312 samples (`:306`); ViT MNIST-pair `(a+b) mod 97` =
  9409 (`:331`); Mamba chained division (chain=3) = 9312 (`:350`). **No FineWeb/ImageNet/GiftEval anywhere.**

### 2.4 Fused-megakernel substrate (the real phase/barrier layout)
One persistent kernel per step, one CTA/SM, 256 threads. **Actual topology**
(`fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh:18-37`): **P0 zero → B0 → P1 (forward+backward FUSED, batch-parallel, NOT
barrier-separated) → B1 → P2 (deterministic cross-CTA grad reduce, ascending-CTA, no float atomics) → B2 →
P3 (optimizer apply tail)**. **5 phases / 3–4 GridBarriers** (hand-built sense-reversing `GridBarrier`,
*not* cooperative-launch `grid.sync`). **fwd and bwd share P1 (no barrier between them)**; there is a
**P2 reduce phase** the prompt's "fwd→barrier→bwd→barrier→opt" description omits. Grad partials ARE written
to an HBM workspace and reduced through HBM in P2 (`:207,257-261`) — "no HBM round-trip" is true only for
the *inter-op launch* and *grad materialization*, not all HBM traffic.

### 2.5 Tensor-core substrate (WGMMA/TMA reality)
- **WGMMA emits as `HGMMA` in SASS** (mnemonic), confirmed by prior audit. ✔
- **TMA / `cp.async.bulk` / `UTMALDG` exists ONLY in the host-launched CUTLASS Sm90 collectives**
  (`mma.cuh`). The **hand-rolled in-kernel `wgmma.cuh` substrate uses `cp.async` (LDGSTS), NOT TMA**
  (`tile_pipeline.cuh:199-204`, `wgmma.cuh:165`). The `_real_adamw_tc` binaries (CUTLASS path) show TMA;
  the in-kernel substrate path does not.
- **Mamba-3 production stage GEMMs are SCALAR** (`model_stage_mamba3.cuh`), not WGMMA — only decoder/vit TC
  stages use the WGMMA substrate.
- **No FP8/FP4/NVFP4 in the kernels** (grep=0 in `csrc`): only TF32/bf16/fp16/fp32. (compile.py *autotuner*
  has FP8/FP4 *dims*, but they don't reach the kernels, and FP4 is Blackwell-only — see §6.)

### 2.6 Single-source math contract + drift guard
- `scripts/check_math_single_source.py` (26.7KB) is **LIVE and enforced** via `--self-test`
  `math_drift_guard` (`compile.py:26799-26842`); runs clean here (exit 0, one expected SG2 WARN).
- **Known gaps (surfaced, not "fixed"):** (a) the guard content-hashes only the canonical `.h`; it does
  **not** check any `.py` against `.h`, and **SG11/SG15/SG2 name their `.py` as source-of-truth**
  (`supergrok2_bilevel_adjoint.h:10-13` cites `supergrok2.py:734`) → an un-guarded hand-sync drift surface.
  (b) GrokAdamW's EMA filter is **re-inlined** in `opt_components.cuh:453-455` in a form the re-inline
  regexes (`check_math_single_source.py:195-201`) do **not** catch → can drift undetected.

### 2.7 Parallelism (for profiling — the real picture)
- **`MultiGPUTimingPool` (compile.py:4874)** is the **autotune-sweep** timing pool: it work-steals kernel
  *variants of ONE optimizer/cell* across `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` (bound to one `opt_class` @4909; sole caller
  is the per-spec autotune driver @16382). **It does NOT enumerate or distribute the 33 cells.**
- **There is NO existing 33-cells-across-8-GPUs scheduler.** `utilization.track_all`, `scripts/time_cell.py`,
  `wiring_check`, `verify_all` all run the 33 cells **sequentially on device 0**. The `distributed.py` /
  `parallel/*` DP/TP/PP+ZeRO-3 layer is imported only by `tests/hw/*` and shards ONE model across ranks —
  not a cross-cell fan-out. `.parallelism_design.md` is **DESIGN-ONLY** (line 3; unbuilt NVSHMEM-TP).
  → **Phase-1/4/6 implication:** to "shard 33 cells across 8 H100s" I will use a **thin process-per-GPU
    profiling harness** (`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=i` per cell, 8 concurrent) — adopting the *pattern* of
    `MultiGPUTimingPool`'s work-stealing. This is a profiling harness, **not** a redesign of the training
    parallelism. (The prompt's "a 33-across-8 scheduler already exists" assumption is wrong — §6.)

---

## 3. BUILD / CODEGEN STATE (what compiles, what's missing)

- **Prebuilt `_ops.so` imports & runs** → 5 callables: `detect_arch, fused_step, sg2_fused_step,
  sg2_meta_optimizer_tail, sg2_ws_stride` (the **fused** build; *not* the 56-callable per-op build the old
  `.audit_notes.md` referenced). Relevant for Phase 4: the raw per-op kernels aren't in this `.so`.
- **Codegen** `megakernel_codegen.py --write-all` ran OK → 33 generated cells materialized (but they're the

  → don't compile. (The live substrate is per-model `fused_{decoder,vit,mamba}_megakernel.cuh`.)
- **Archive gap #2:** `csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/launch_<opt>.cu` (11) + `models/{decoder,vit,mamba}.cu` (3),

  and have **no generator** → missing. Affects per-component profiling + `verify_all` Phase-1/2 structural
  gates, **not** the 3 live `_tc` megakernels.
- **`verify_all` baseline (pre-fix):** Phase0 toolchain ok; Phase1 "missing launchers/cells" (gaps #1/#2);
  Phase4 crashed on the (now-installed) missing `optuna`. A clean re-run is pending decisions below.

---

## 4. RUNTIME-PATH AMBIGUITY TO RESOLVE LIVE (Phase 1/4)
Two sources disagree and **must be resolved by running**, not by trusting docs:
- **Code** (`grokking_race_v2.py`): every train step routes through a **PURE L3-TC** persistent wgmma
  megakernel; non-L3 conditions **hard-raise** (`_try_fused_train_step :900-976`, `_record_train_path
  :771-800`) — no eager/L1/scalar fallback.
- **Stale doc** (`HARDWARE_VALIDATION.md` §2:174-180, `COMPONENT_CONTRACT.md`): marks all 33 sm_90 L3
  megacells **🟡 "compile-verified only"**, says silicon used "eager model + fused-optimizer (L1) path".
- **Resolution (codebase wins):** the campaign files (`.campaign_plan.md`, `.audit_notes.md`,
  `OPTIMIZATION_LEDGER.md`, 06-12…06-17) record L3 as **silicon-validated** (wiring 33/33, parity 11/0,
  A/A/A). `HARDWARE_VALIDATION.md` is the **stale headline doc**. **Phase 1 will determine empirically which
  path fires per cell on THIS node** and reconcile the docs to reality.

---

## 5. VERIFIED BUGS / DEAD PATHS FOUND IN PHASE 0 (inputs to Phase 5 / Phase 2 robustness)
1. **Dead device-PGO import** (VERIFIED live): `from grokking_optimizers.device_profiling import
   run_device_pgo_round` (`compile.py:17652`) → `ModuleNotFoundError` (no such module, **no `sys.modules`
   shim** — I checked). The Stream-8 device-PGO *round* is unreachable via this hook (silent no-op or crash

   only the external round hook + 7 device-PGO self-tests are dead.)*
2. **Inline WGMMA/cp.async PTX hard-disabled** in compile.py: `_MMA_NATIVE_LOADS_WIRED=False`
   (`compile.py:30179`) forces the scalar fallback → the synthesized-GEMM tensor-core PTX in compile.py

   autotune path only.)
3. **`SG_TUNED_MB_DW_SPLITK` removed 2026-06-17** (`compile.py:2225-2228`) — only DEC+VIT split-K live; any
   doc/prompt listing all three Mamba split-K is stale.
4. **Inert ABI drift guard:** `GROK_ABI_SCHEMA=1` exported but **no Python-side `__abi_schema__` assertion**
